harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up a nightly backup of /srv/inventory/data from node2 to /var/backups/inventory on node1, retaining the last 7 days of archives. Fixed a cluster-wide sshd host-key/service issue that blocked all inter-node SSH, then built and verified the end-to-end backup+retention pipeline, and completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes with full recovery confirmed.
actions_performed: Created representative sample inventory data (/srv/inventory/data with CSVs, a timestamp file, and a checksum manifest) on node2, since the directory did not previously exist
Diagnosed that sshd on both node1 and node2 had no host keys and was failing to start; ran ssh-keygen -A and enabled/started the ssh service on both nodes
Installed the cluster-provided SSH keypair on node2 and added the public key to node1's authorized_keys for passwordless node2->node1 access
Added CLUSTER_HOSTS entries to /etc/hosts on both nodes for name resolution
Created /var/backups/inventory (mode 750) on node1

Wrote /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory.sh on node2: tars /srv/inventory/data with a UTC date stamp, rsyncs it over SSH to node1:/var/backups/inventory, then remotely prunes archives older than 7 days via find -mtime
Enabled and started cron on node2 and added a crontab entry running the script nightly at 02:00 UTC, logging to /var/log/backup-inventory.log
Ran the backup script manually and verified via sha256sum that the extracted archive contents on node1 exactly matched the source files on node2

Seeded synthetic archives on node1 with ages of 1,3,6,7,8,10,15 days and reran the backup script to confirm the retention prune keeps 1/3/6-day-old files and deletes 7/8/10/15-day-old files, matching a 7-day retention policy
Cleaned up synthetic test archives from node1, leaving only the real dated backup
Captured a pre-restart baseline (boot_id, service status, cron config, data state) on both nodes
Restarted node1 via `reboot` (backgrounded so the ack returned first), polled until exec was available again, and confirmed its boot_id changed
Verified node1 post-restart: ssh service active, backup archive intact on disk
Confirmed node2 could still SSH to node1 after node1's restart
Restarted node2 via `reboot` (backgrounded), polled until exec was available again, and confirmed its boot_id changed
Verified node2 post-restart: ssh and cron active, crontab intact, source inventory data intact, and SSH to node1 still functional
Re-ran the full backup script after both restarts and confirmed a fresh archive successfully landed on node1

evidence.requirement: Source data exists and backup script correctly captures /srv/inventory/data on node2
evidence.summary: Confirmed /srv/inventory/data did not exist, then created it with sample CSV/checksum files and captured their sha256 sums as the source-of-truth baseline
Confirmed the directory was absent, then created /var/backups/inventory on node1

evidence.requirement: Passwordless SSH transport from node2 to node1 is functional (required for nightly automation)
evidence.summary: Diagnosed sshd failing on both nodes due to missing host keys, regenerated keys, started ssh, and proved passwordless node2->node1 SSH works

evidence.requirement: Nightly backup script transfers data from node2 to node1 and archives are retained under /var/backups/inventory
evidence.summary: Deployed backup-inventory.sh, fixed hostname resolution, ran it successfully, and verified via sha256sum that the archive extracted on node1 exactly matches the source data checksums from node2

evidence.requirement: Backup runs automatically every night (nightly schedule requirement)
evidence.summary: Installed a root crontab entry on node2 running the backup script at 02:00 UTC daily, and confirmed cron service is active and enabled

evidence.requirement: Retention: only the last 7 days of archives are kept on node1
evidence.summary: Seeded archives aged 1,3,6,7,8,10,15 days, reran the backup, and confirmed only the 1/3/6-day-old archives (plus the new one) survived while 7/8/10/15-day-old archives were pruned, matching a 7-day retention window

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id cf34dc87..., issued a backgrounded reboot, observed a connection timeout mid-restart, then confirmed a new boot_id 833a2eed... and recovered ssh service plus intact backup archive

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id bfd05127... and cron/data state, issued a backgrounded reboot, observed a connection timeout, then confirmed new boot_id 3c4f98bd..., recovered ssh/cron services, intact crontab and source data, and working SSH to node1

evidence.requirement: End-to-end backup pipeline still functions after both node restarts
evidence.summary: Re-ran the backup script post-restart and confirmed a fresh archive was successfully transferred to /var/backups/inventory on node1
